content.thinking: The cache looks like a stale copy of the real state, and I'm treating state divergence as the likely failure mode, with io-summary-cache as the probable subject. I don't know yet when it started serving stale data; the 17:56 mark is when it fell behind.

hypotheses.summary: The cached spend totals (io-summary-cache) stopped keeping up with the purchase ledger from 2026-11-07T17:56:00Z. The ledger is correct and the cached copies are stale. 90 of 240 figures disagree, and each one goes stale again when its shopper buys. No deploy, flag or placement change explains it, and no metrics or logs were available to show request impact.

supporting_evidence.claim: 90 of 240 cached spend figures disagree with the purchases behind them. The purchases are correct and the cached copies are behind... the oldest purchase none of them account for was recorded at 2026-11-07T17:56:00Z, which is when the copies stopped keeping up.
get_changes returned 'nothing changed in this window' for 2026-11-06T20:00:00Z to 2026-11-07T20:54:23Z, and for the five days before that.
All three pods are on Tesla-V100-SXM2-16GB nodes and started 2026-11-07T08:54:22Z, so no pod moved to a different card. Metrics are empty and there are no logs.
io-summary-cache: internal, owned by checkout-platform. Holds a shopper's spend figure so the account page does not have to walk their purchase history. Optional by design.
